feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: International news, global reporting and analysis from NPR. Plus dispatches from NPR’s State of the World podcast.

entry.title: This legendary board game could take decades to complete
entry.summary: Andy Taeger & James Purcell are trying to become the first people ever complete the board game Campaign for North Africa. The is so complex it could take decades to finish.

entry.title: Gulf region on edge as Qatar leads talks with Iran to stave off new U.S. attacks
entry.summary: Qatar has been leading intense mediation efforts over the past 72 hours to prevent a new round of possible U.S. attacks on Iran after Tuesday's midterm elections. The uncertainty has the entire Gulf region on edge.

entry.title: They signed up for a lifetime at sea on an endless cruise. High gas prices intervened
entry.summary: A cruise ship suspended operations suddenly, citing soaring fuel costs. Passengers, including Randy Cassingham, had to disembark in Cambodia. NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to Cassingham about the ordeal.

entry.title: Secretary Rubio has a tough time getting officials at G20 on the same page
entry.summary: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is hosting the G20 foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta, with a focus on economic and security challenges.

entry.title: A new political era in the Southern Philippines
entry.summary: A new local government has taken its seat in the southern Philippines, in a step that marks a milestone in the peace process for a conflict that has lasted some 80 years.

entry.title: France seethes again as youth-led protests sweep Europe
entry.summary: French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez warned of a "very high risk" of disorder, especially after dark on Halloween, as some 320,000 people nationwide took to the streets.

entry.title: Key takeaways from this week's political meeting in Beijing
entry.summary: The Communist party central committee meeting was focused on discipline and fighting corruption. It comes ahead of next year when Xi is widely expected to try to secure a fourth term.

entry.title: Drone photo award winners: Far-out landscapes. Ship recycling. Rugs, rugs rugs!
entry.summary: The Siena Drone Photo Awards for 2026 offer breathtaking bird's-eye views of our planet, revealing landscapes, livelihoods and human stories often invisible from the ground.

entry.title: Blockchain intelligence firms link North Korea to $6.3B hack on Binance
entry.summary: The world's biggest cryptocurrency exchange reported Thursday that approximately $6.3 billion was impacted in an apparent hack.

entry.title: Alaska's Senate race faces claims of spoiler candidate. And, Hegseth ousts Army general
entry.summary: Alaska's governor ordered an investigation into claims that Dems recruited a spoiler candidate to confuse voters. And, Hegseth ousted an Army general as the U.S. prepares for potential attacks on Iran.
